en.title: 8 Must-Watch Shows If You Loved The Legend of Vox Machina
en.summary: Finished the latest adventures of Vox Machina and craving more? Dive into these animated fantasy epics that capture the same magic.
en.body:
## 1. Critical Role
Before the animated series brought their epic tales to life, Critical Role itself was the phenomenon. This livestreamed Dungeons & Dragons campaign, featuring a cast of professional voice actors, is the very source material that inspired The Legend of Vox Machina, offering hundreds of hours of deep lore and character development.

## 2. Dota: Dragon's Blood
If you're drawn to the intricate world-building and high-stakes fantasy combat of Vox Machina, Dota: Dragon's Blood is a must-see. This Netflix series, produced by Studio Mir (The Legend of Korra), delivers stunning animation and a mature storyline centered around a dragon knight and an elven princess.

## 3. Castlevania
For those who appreciate the darker, more adult-oriented fantasy and visceral action of Vox Machina, Castlevania on Netflix is a perfect fit. The series, based on the iconic Konami video game franchise, features complex characters, brutal combat, and a compelling narrative driven by its voice cast.

## 4. Arcane
While perhaps more grounded in a steampunk-inspired world than pure high fantasy, Arcane on Netflix shares Vox Machina's commitment to exceptional animation quality and character-driven storytelling. This series, set in the League of Legends universe, explores themes of family, conflict, and sacrifice with stunning visual flair and emotional depth.

## 5. The Dragon Prince
Brought to life by many of the same animation talents behind Avatar: The Last Airbender, The Dragon Prince offers a more family-friendly, yet still engaging, fantasy adventure. It masterfully blends humor, heart, and a sprawling quest to reunite two princes with a young elf to stop a war, echoing Vox Machina's core of unlikely heroes.

## 6. Invincible
If the blend of superhero action, mature themes, and surprisingly deep character arcs in Vox Machina appealed to you, then Invincible on Amazon Prime Video is essential viewing. From the mind of Robert Kirkman, this animated series delivers shocking twists and incredible fight sequences, all while exploring the complexities of heroism and legacy.

## 7. Blood of Zeus
Another visually striking Netflix series from the creators of Castlevania, Blood of Zeus plunges viewers into Greek mythology with a dose of divine intervention and mortal struggles. Its epic scope, focus on legendary heroes, and brutal battles make it a natural follow-up for fans of Vox Machina's grand fantasy scale.

## 8. Record of Lodoss War: Chronicles of the Heroic Knight
For a classic take on Dungeons & Dragons-style fantasy, the anime series Record of Lodoss War is a foundational text. This 1998 series, often cited as an inspiration for many Western fantasy works, follows a group of adventurers on a quest filled with magic, monsters, and ancient evils, much like the journey of Vox Machina.
Bottom Line: These animated fantasy epics offer thrilling adventures, compelling characters, and stunning visuals that will satisfy your craving after finishing The Legend of Vox Machina.

content_raw: Fans of fantasy adventures, memorable characters, and tabletop storytelling have plenty of excellent shows to enjoy after finishing The Legend of Vox Machina.
